wikipediaCheck.evidenceLocator: Live shared-list section, lines 1934–1943: lists Zebadiah of 1CH27:7, 2CH17:7–8, 2CH19:8–11, 1CH8:15, 1CH26:2; does not identify the son of Jeroham of Gedor at 1CH12:7.; Live article lines 102–108: line 105 says a Benjamite named Jeroham is mentioned at 1CH12:7 but does not name Zebadiah as his son; it is about the father, not the target individual.
